title: Quarterly Income Tax Return for Individuals, Estates and Trusts

validation.how: No input is highlighted at all; messages are listed only in a Needs review section after Part III (first 25), and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

findings.now: Item 1 year and Item 2 quarter stay editable after the tile set them; Save draft under another year or quarter overwrites any saved Draft for that key, and a blank year is saved as year 0.
findings.why: Drafts are keyed by TIN, form, year and quarter taken from the draft as it stands after sync, and upsert_from_draft updates the row that matches.

options.name: Read-only period from the tile
options.detail: Show year and quarter as text set by the tile, so the key cannot change on this page.

options.name: Restricted period choices
options.detail: Offer only the tile's year and quarter, or periods with no saved Draft.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft and Queue when the period differs from the saved key or the year is blank.

findings.field: 59A — Tax paid in return previously filed (amended)
findings.now: After Item 3 changes, disabled amount boxes keep their old figures and the totals ignore them; switching back shows a figure the totals do not yet include, until the next keystroke.
findings.why: edit() recomputes the draft but never reloads the input text, and set_value runs only once at construction, so the boxes go stale.

options.name: Reload inputs after edit
options.detail: Copy the 1701MS pattern: sync first, apply the change, then reset every input from the draft.

options.name: Clear hidden lines
options.detail: When recompute disables a line, clear its text so the box never shows an amount the draft does not hold.

findings.now: No input is highlighted when validation fails; the reasons appear only in the Needs review list after Part III, and Queue for submission is disabled.
findings.why: field() has no error check at all, so the user cannot see which box holds the problem.

options.name: Red label as on 1702EX
options.detail: Reuse the field() error check so the label turns red when its key is in validation_errors.

options.name: Message under the field
options.detail: Show the message text beneath the input, matching the Needs review entry.

findings.now: Six chips with long labels, such as 'II012 Business Income - Graduated IT Rates', sit in one row.
findings.why: Six single-value choices with long labels read better as one combobox than as a chip row.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Single-select combobox showing the code and label for each of the six ATCs.

options.name: Wrapped chip grid
options.detail: Keep the chips in a wrapping grid with equal widths (acceptable, but noisier).

findings.now: Seven chips wrap across the row, and all are disabled when the spouse is a compensation earner.
findings.why: Seven single-value options exceed the button limit, and the compensation case is already fixed by the model.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Single-select combobox with the seven codes; keep it disabled when the spouse is a compensation earner.

options.name: Read-only chip for compensation
options.detail: Show Compensation Income as one read-only chip when Item 19 is Compensation Earner.

findings.now: No control shows Items 32–35, so payment details cannot be entered on the desktop.
findings.why: The draft holds payment_details, but the view never renders them and the submit map (form_1701q_official.rs:602) never writes them.

options.name: Add a payment block
options.detail: Show the four payment rows under Part III and write them into the submit map.

options.name: State the gap on the page
options.detail: Tell the user that payment details are completed outside the app.

findings.now: When every check passes, no line says 'Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.'
findings.why: The official validate() shows this alert on success, and the page renders only the error list.

options.name: Success line in the review slot
options.detail: Show the verbatim success text where the Needs review list would be when there are no errors.

options.name: Status bar message
options.detail: Show the same text in the status message bar after a clean check.
